versions.subject: feat: add qakbot related rules
versions.detection:
selection_paths:
    ParentImage|endswith:
        # Note: Only add processes seen used by Qakbot to avoid collision with other strains of malware
        - '\cmd.exe'
        - '\cscript.exe'
        - '\curl.exe'
        - '\mshta.exe'
        - '\powershell.exe'
        - '\pwsh.exe'
        - '\wscript.exe'
    Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
        # Note: Only add paths seen used by Qakbot to avoid collision with other strains of malware
        - ':\ProgramData\'
        - ':\Users\Public\'
        - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
        - '\AppData\Roaming\'
selection_exports:
    CommandLine|endswith:
        # Note: Only add additional exports seen used by Qakbot
        - ',aslr' # https://tria.ge/230524-scgq9add9v/behavioral1#report
        - ',DrawThemeIcon'
        - ',GG10'
        - ',GL70'
        - ',jhbvygftr'
        - ',kjhbhkjvydrt'
        - ',LS88'
        - ',Motd'
        - ',N115'
        - ',Nikn'
        - ',print'
        - ',qqqb'
        - ',qqqq'
        - ',RS32'
        - ',Test'
        - ',Time'
        - ',Updt'
        - ',vips'
        - ',Wind'
        - ',WW50'
        - ',X555'
        - ',XL55'
        - ',xlAutoOpen'
        - ',XS88'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: ParentImage IN ("*\\cmd.exe", "*\\cscript.exe", "*\\curl.exe", "*\\mshta.exe", "*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe", "*\\wscript.exe") Image="*\\rundll32.exe" CommandLine IN ("*:\\ProgramData\\*", "*:\\Users\\Public\\*", "*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*", "*\\AppData\\Roaming\\*") CommandLine IN ("*,aslr", "*,DrawThemeIcon", "*,GG10", "*,GL70", "*,jhbvygftr", "*,kjhbhkjvydrt", "*,LS88", "*,Motd", "*,N115", "*,Nikn", "*,print", "*,qqqb", "*,qqqq", "*,RS32", "*,Test", "*,Time", "*,Updt", "*,vips", "*,Wind", "*,WW50", "*,X555", "*,XL55", "*,xlAutoOpen", "*,XS88")
